heading: Questions? We can read your mind

items.q: What is the BBA (Hons) in Artificial Intelligence & Emerging Technologies at ATLAS?
a: ATLAS ISME BBA (Hons) in Artificial Intelligence & Emerging Technologies is a 4-year undergraduate program that prepares young learners to navigate and lead in an AI-driven world.

items.q: Is this a management program or a technology program?
a: It is a program that blends experiential learning with theory and integrates essential business management skills. It helps students gain knowledge about different kinds of technologies and prepares them for the AI-driven future.

items.q: Does the program include hands-on training or internships?
a: Yes, the program is inclusive of hands-on training and internships. Through multiple internships, capstone projects and hands-on tool training and introduction to Emerging Technologies, Principles of Marketing in the AI Era, Programming & Analytics Cloud Computing and Virtualisation, Flexibility, Agility and Resilience (FAR) Skills, students can gain experience for a brighter future.

items.q: What careers can I pursue after this BBA in AI & Emerging Technologies?
a: There are multiple roles graduates can pursue after completing a BBA in AI & Emerging Technologies. Different roles, such as business and AI integration roles, data and analytics roles, emerging tech and digital roles and sector-specific roles, can be pursued by the graduates.

items.q: Is this program appropriate for students who want to establish a tech-based business?
a: Yes, those individuals who are keen on setting up a tech-based business can highly benefit from this program. They can become a tech startup founder or an AI venture analyst. They can even have their own digital business consultancy firm for SMEs.

items.q: What are the eligibility criteria for this BBA program in AI & Emerging Technologies?
a: To apply for the BBA (Hons.) in Artificial Intelligence & Emerging Technologies at ATLAS SkillTech University, candidates must:

items: Have completed or be appearing for Class 12 (10+2) or equivalent from a recognised board
Have a minimum of 50% aggregate marks
